liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Reuben & Cherise** (4 reviews): Reviewer never expected to see the band play Reuben and Cherise live; Reviewer calls this the best Rubin they have heard, a rarity for the band [24][25][26][31]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Reviewer calls this a great version of Loose Lucy [21]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's Band after Estimated Prophet is described as moving enough to bring tears [22]
- **All Along the Watchtower** (1 review): The transition out of Drums and Space into All Along the Watchtower is called a masterpiece [22]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): The Stella Blue that follows is suggested as possibly the best ever played [22]
- **Box of Rain** (1 review): The show closed with Box of Rain as the encore [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-27.120857.sbd.miller.flac24** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 183 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-03-27.172999.mtx.seamons.ht178.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: For about a minute during Drums, the audience source picks up a distinct echo from the PA [7]
- **gd1991-03-27.149559.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 189 min [11]
- **gd91-03-27.sbd.miller.14486.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 176 min; rated 3.94/5 by 17 [13]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality is good; Phil's bass during New Minglewood stands out on a good stereo; Reviewer found the sound thin and blowy, especially in the first set, as if on rented gear; A prominent hiss runs through the whole recording, audible in the gap between Minglewood and Row Jimmy [21][26][27][28]
- **gd1991-03-27.sbd.harrison-braverman.ladner.10310.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 176 min [14]. Said about its sound: A quarter-second dropout occurs about 3:45 into Fire on the Mountain [14]

## Around the show

- Jerry reportedly played his old Wolf guitar, a 1970s instrument, for Rubin and Cherise [23]
- Vince's carnival-style organ may give some listeners a headache [28]
- By the end of the first set the whole arena was electrified [31]
- Reuben and Cerise was played only four times by the band, making it this show's highlight [21]
- Greensboro tends to overshadow a strong Nassau run on the East Coast spring 1991 tour, this night especially [23]
- Reviewer likes the JGB versions of Rubin and Cherise, but says they don't match this one [25]
- Reviewer considers it fairly well played but low on the list of 1991 shows [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-27.120857.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]
- **gd1991-03-27.172999.mtx.seamons.ht178.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [7]. Also: Soundboard was pitch corrected faster by 0.6 to 0.8 percent; dropouts in Minglewood Blues and Row Jimmy were patched from audience tape; UltraMatrix soundboard became drier from Loose Lucy on, so audience levels were raised in the mix [7]
- **gd1991-03-27.149559.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 18, 2020; source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (110°) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: FOB mics hand held, section B1, row 19, seat 8 [11]
- **gd91-03-27.sbd.miller.14486.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> Cm (Sony D5) -> Dat via Charlie Miller w/ encore from unknown aud [13]
- **gd1991-03-27.sbd.harrison-braverman.ladner.10310.shnf**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: Soundboard [14]. Also: Box of Rain comes from an audience DAT source, while the rest is soundboard; A cassette flip falls between Drums and Space, probably losing little [14]

Soundboard was pitch corrected faster by 0.6 to 0.8 percent; dropouts in Minglewood Blues and Row Jimmy were patched from audience tape
UltraMatrix soundboard became drier from Loose Lucy on, so audience levels were raised in the mix
For about a minute during Drums, the audience source picks up a distinct echo from the PA
Recorded by Dave Brotman and Jeff Metchick on Schoeps microphones; Charlie Miller did the transfer
Box of Rain comes from an audience DAT source, while the rest is soundboard
A cassette flip falls between Drums and Space, probably losing little
A quarter-second dropout occurs about 3:45 into Fire on the Mountain
